sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 3 April 2026, pitch SYN-SYNCP000112-P1 was put before Harborview Regional Hospital 112 on behalf of Supplier.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 1 rebate of 3 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Influenza minimum take of 2,650 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer signed off on the terms.
